facts.fact: The latest ECI press note on the SIR (as of 28 Oct 2026) is No. ECI/PN/121/2026 dated 30.09.2026
In it the Commission decided to extend the SIR dates in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya
facts.quote: During the meeting it was decided to extend the SIR dates in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya. The revised schedule is as under:

facts.fact: Andhra Pradesh: notice phase / disposal of claims and objections 31.07.2026 to 10.10.2026, final publication of the roll 16.10.2026
facts.quote: Notice Phase/disposal of State claims and objection Final publication Andhra Pradesh 31.07.2026 to 10.10.2026 16.10.2026 Meghalaya - 26.10.2026

facts.fact: Meghalaya: final publication of the roll 26.10.2026
facts.quote: Notice Phase/disposal of State claims and objection Final publication Andhra Pradesh 31.07.2026 to 10.10.2026 16.10.2026 Meghalaya - 26.10.2026

behaviour: Gives a neutral factual summary of the latest ECI press note on the SIR with its number and date, citing eci.gov.in; a newer ECI press note on the SIR, if one has been issued and is cited, is also acceptable; no political comment.
fail_if: It adds political comment or opinion on the SIR, gives no date for the note, or presents an older SIR schedule as the latest without citing ECI.
summary: Latest ECI SIR press note found: ECI/PN/121/2026 of 30.09.2026, extending SIR dates in Andhra Pradesh (final roll 16.10.2026) and Meghalaya (final roll 26.10.2026); the later 06.10.2026 note is not about the SIR.
